title: We had to feed our cat medicine with a syringe
text: We had to feed our cat medicine with a syringe and I took photos because he looked stupid and my built in camera seems to have some enhancement bullshit so it merged two frames of my cat into one so now he's a still life. https://t.co/9xmYcIDVk2
blurb: Their black cat got a syringe dose of medicine and looked so ridiculous mid-dose that the camera's "enhancement" merged two frames into one goofy still life — pink tongue out, eyes half-lost in the blur.
